name: alto-belt
description: Coaches you from White to Black belt on AltoTech's Claude Code rubric: a live score per repository from how you work (tests before commits, PR evidence, correction streaks, context fill, instructions, hooks, review setup), the next three changes, one quiet nudge when a habit slips, an animated belt page in your browser that updates live (/belt web), and the self-guided programme as a skill. Counts stay on your machine; no prompt text is kept

band.title: Line above the prompt
band.description: On: one line above the prompt when a habit slips. Off: nothing is drawn there.

status.title: Belt in the status line
status.description: On: the status line shows your belt and score in this repository.

coach_model.title: Coach Claude too
coach_model.description: Off: Claude's instructions are unchanged. On: adds one short section asking Claude to request a verifier, show output before saying done, and suggest /clear after two failed corrections.
